AMENDMENT — add DD4 (override-propagation), from the overall-plan coherence review (2026-06-04), CONFIRMED in code this session. FP-recovery cleared PR1 #631's SHAs but recorded them nowhere; review-coverage-invariant.yml:56 sets only DSO_REVIEWED_LEDGER (never DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER), so the consult path at review-coverage-invariant.sh:179 (ael_sha_is_exempt) is DEAD in CI, and FP-recovery never calls ael_append. Under WARN mode PR2 #632 passed; under ENFORCE (3ee4) a future PR2 would fail-closed on FP-recovered SHAs -> a SECOND admin override per PR.
DD4: (a) wire FP-recovery (+ the web-UI admin bypass) to `ael_append <ledger> <sha> "fp-recovery:<reviewer-hash>" "<rationale>"` for the merged SHAs; (b) set DSO_ADMIN_EXEMPTION_LEDGER in review-coverage-invariant.yml + persist the ledger; (c) provision the .closure-key HMAC file (in the tickets orphan branch) to the coverage-invariant CI job (sub-gap G-A). Mechanism EXISTS (story 2730, CLOSED) -> this is WIRING, not new design. Belongs with DD3's fp-recovery escalation surface. HARD PREREQUISITE for the enforce-flip (3ee4 / P8).
